column1: # kind  name  key  description  flags
mode  sessions   -  tmux sessions                         default
mode  windows    -  windows across all sessions           -
mode  panes      -  panes across all sessions             -
mode  buffers    -  paste buffers                         -
mode  keys       -  key bindings in every table           -
mode  commands   -  command signatures                   -
mode  options    -  server, session, window and pane options  -
mode  variables  -  format variables and current values  -
mode  styles     -  style options                         -
mode  formats    -  format templates with rendered samples  -
mode  status     -  rendered status-left and status-right   -
mode  hooks      -  hooks by scope                         -
toggle  changed  alt-d  keys/options/hooks: only changes and local overrides    -
toggle  unassigned  alt-u  keys: show free keys in the selected table           -
toggle  empty    alt-e  variables and hooks: include empty values               -
toggle  short    alt-c  commands: show names and aliases only                   -
action  switch  alt-s   switch to session, window or pane (attach outside tmux)  become
action  kill    ctrl-x  kill session, window, pane or delete buffer            foreground,reload,confirm
action  rename  alt-n   rename session, window or pane title                  foreground,reload
action  move    alt-m   move window to session or pane to another pane        foreground,reload
action  swap    -       swap two windows or panes                             foreground,reload
action  link    -       link window into another session                      foreground,reload
action  mark    -       mark selected pane                                    silent,reload
action  paste   alt-p   paste the buffer into the origin pane                 silent
action  next-session  -  switch to the next session matching the prefix        become
action  prev-session  -  switch to the previous session matching the prefix    become
action  theme-main    -  apply the main theme to the selected session           foreground,reload
action  theme-float   -  apply the floating theme to the selected session       foreground,reload
action  scratch       -  open the scratch popup shell                          foreground
action  nvim-layout   -  open the nvim editor and log layout                     foreground
action  nvim          -  reference lists: open the whole list in nvim (ft=tmux)   foreground
